events.description: Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani is thanking Rachel Green for the coffee that Rachel Green just served to Joey Tribbiani.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is thanking Rachel Green for the hot cider that Rachel Green just gave to Monica Geller.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller's cinnamon stick in Monica Geller's hot cider has an eraser attached.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green accidentally gave Monica Geller a pencil instead of a cinnamon stick, which is why Monica Geller's cinnamon stick has an eraser.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green is sorry for accidentally giving Monica Geller a pencil instead of a cinnamon stick.
